decisions.reason: Gives paste_image/paste_file with (2),(3)... max-existing-suffix+1 until unused, applied only on the paste acquisition path before add(), reserves within batch (re-scan after each item) and across live attachments via snapshot occurrences; drop/picker explicitly keep real names; grounded in fixture add()/record.label/item.path. Extension/MIME details correctly presented as unscored guidance, not relied on.

Identifies input.state.getSnapshot().occurrences as the authoritative occupied-name source and explains the alive-subscription records.delete(ref) fires on a momentarily empty snapshot while the attachment is still live, citing the fixture code comment; accounts for in-batch reservations via per-item re-scan and treats records as a display cache only.

Grounds diagnosis in the captured x-cache HIT, age 178, s-maxage 300 response listing only v0.2.9-v0.2.7, and renderCurrentChip(tag) printing the fetched tag; prescribes semantic comparison: semverCmp(latest, PLUGIN_VERSION) <= 0 renders the running PLUGIN_VERSION, > 0 renders the fetched tag, never an older fetched tag.

Proposes concrete tests for same-batch and cross-paste distinct names with exact expected labels/paths, the records-cache trap (empty snapshot while occurrence live must still block the name, expected paste_image(2).png), unchanged drop/picker names, and stale/equal vs genuinely newer remote tags with specific mock values and chip-text assertions.

Grounded in the hand-inlined PLUGIN_VERSION in lib/client.js: requires version-equality gate with package.json, node --check of lib artifacts plus behavioral regressions, and explains users receive updates only by re-acquiring the served artifact and hard-refreshing; explicitly notes a tag/chip cannot install and there is no host-side update endpoint.
